notification-inbox.title: Inbox
notification-inbox.intro: Task assignments, discussion mentions, handoff and review requests for you in the current project.
notification-inbox.handoff_requested: You were asked to take responsibility for a task
notification-inbox.assignment_changed: Assignment has changed since this notification.
notification-inbox.empty.inbox: No assignment notifications in your inbox
notification-inbox.empty_hint: New assignments, explicit mentions, handoff and review requests appear here. Earlier events are not backfilled.
notification-inbox.scope_hint: Counts cover your current project, including pages not loaded. Pages are separate live reads. Opening a task does not mark it read; these actions change only your notification state.
notification-inbox.original_update_hint: The earlier update has no confirmed result. Restore its original receipt before updating another notification or leaving this view.
notification-inbox.update_confirmed_newe: The original update was confirmed. The newer notification state shown here was retained.
notification-inbox.invalid_filter: This inbox filter is invalid. No broader query was made. Choose a filter to continue.
notification-inbox.invalid_read: Your current inbox could not be confirmed. Refresh to read it again.
notification-inbox.page_changed: Notifications changed while loading. Refresh to start from the first page.
notification-inbox.refresh_failed: The current notification state could not be read. Retry before making another update.
notification-inbox.access_changed: Access to this inbox has changed.
notification-inbox.private_cleared: Private notification and task details have been cleared. Retry to check your current access.
notification-inbox.keywords: inbox notifications assignments read unread archive
